snippet.title: Diablo Immortal x Berserk - Official Developer Interview - FGS Live From gamescom latam
snippet.description:
An exclusive interview revealing fresh details on the exciting new collaboration with classic Japanese anime series Berserk and Diablo Immortal, the hugely popular free-to-play MMO action RPG from Activision Blizzard. Diablo Immortal’s lead artist explains why the collaboration is such a natural fit, and how they designed new characters inspired by the Berserk universe, plus recreated iconic scenes from the anime that is considered one of the greatest of all time. The Diablo Immortal x Berserk collaboration is coming to PC and mobile on May 1, and will be available in Diablo IV from May 6, 2025.
